title: Decorative Tiles in Pakistan: Handmade, Patterned, Star Designs
excerpt: A guide to decorative tiles in Pakistan: handmade and patterned terracotta, star-and-cross shapes, glazed mosaics and jali, and how to choose.
meta_title: Decorative Tiles in Pakistan: Designs and Guide
meta_description: Decorative tiles in Pakistan: handmade terracotta, star-and-cross shapes, glazed mosaics and jali. Learn what suits floors and walls and how to order.
answer_box: Decorative tiles are chosen mainly for shape, pattern, colour or finish rather than plain coverage. In Pakistan they range from handmade terracotta hexagons and star-and-cross shapes to glazed mosaics and jali screens. Pick by use first, floor or wall, then confirm size, finish and batch with a physical sample.
ai_summary: Decorative tiles in Pakistan include handmade terracotta shapes, star-and-cross patterns, glazed ceramic mosaics and jali screens, each suited to different floors and walls. Handmade tiles vary slightly in shade and size, and Moroccan, Hala and hand painted tiles are different crafts that Pak Clay does not list. Pak Clay Tiles, making clay tiles in Lahore since 1982, offers free samples and dated quotes on WhatsApp.
author: Pak Clay Team

faqs.question: What are decorative tiles?
faqs.answer: Decorative tiles are chosen mainly for shape, pattern, colour or finish, and are used as feature floors, borders, wall panels, backsplashes or screens. They can be clay, ceramic, stone or cement.

faqs.question: Are decorative tiles more expensive than plain tiles?
faqs.answer: Often shaped or handmade tiles take more work than plain squares, but the rate also depends on size, finish, quantity, city and date. We do not print figures; ask for a dated written quote.

faqs.question: Are star-and-cross tiles the same as Moroccan tiles?
faqs.answer: No. Star-and-cross is a geometric pattern. Moroccan zellige is a specific hand-cut glazed craft, and Pak Clay does not list it. Our terracotta and ceramic star sets borrow the geometry in a different product.

faqs.question: Does Pak Clay sell hand painted or Hala tiles?
faqs.answer: They are not in our catalogue as listed items. Send a picture and your quantity on WhatsApp and we will tell you whether it is something we can arrange, without promising before we check.

faqs.question: How do I order decorative tiles from Pak Clay?
faqs.answer: Message us on WhatsApp with your city, area, use and the tile you like. We offer a free sample and reply with a dated written quote.
